newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russian minister wants more Japan investment--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Russian minister wants more Japan investment--MOF.

text.p: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov wants more Japanese direct investment in Russia, a Ministry of Finance (MOF) official quoted him as saying on Monday.

Nemtsov, who is in Tokyo this week as part of an 80-strong delegation aimed at courting new Japanese investment, met with Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka earlier. He is expected to meet with Japanese business leaders later on Monday, the official told reporters.
Nemtsov was quoted as saying that the value of Japan's direct investment in Russia stood at only about $227 million, an amount which he deemed to be insufficient.

It would be good to direct such investment into the development of natural resources, although Russia hoped Japanese direct investment would also go into the lumber and food industries, Nemtsov was quoted as telling Mitsuzuka.
